limitations: Matches the instruction shape; a pinned digest in the same file is not evaluated.

provenance.writtenFor: Ultimate Master Pump synthetic evaluation breadth (2026-10-19)
provenance.kind: synthetic test fixture - NOT vulnerability intelligence

purpose: A Dockerfile fetches a build artefact over the network with ADD instead of verifying a local copy.

groundTruth.rationale: ADD of a remote URL pulls content that the build does not pin by digest, so the image inherits whatever the remote server returns at build time.
